thread:
Carmen: Quick sync — I'm sketching DP trajectory metrics + rollout gates for the private preview. Want to land on measurable thresholds and a small incentive experiment. High-level idea: staggered cohorts, canary release to 10% partners, expand if metrics hold. Thoughts?
Ben: Love the canary approach. Can we make commit rate the primary gate? e.g., >30% active commitment within 7 days. Also require no quality regression >2%. :thumbsup:
Raj: How are we measuring regression? auto-eval on a fixed prompt set or cohort-driven human checks?
Sophie: Recommend both: automated evals daily + weekly sampled human reviews (10 sessions/week). Auto-eval = regression on BLEU-ish/semantic sim + fuzz checks. Human checks for safety/latency weirdness.
Kevin: Capacity note: if we open to 10% of partners concurrently we need to cap token throughput. Suggest a soft cap and a queue fallback that serves a smaller model variant. @devops FYI.
Carmen: Good catch. We'll add cost/capacity gate: average latency p95 < 800ms and token/sec below reserved burst. If burst exceeded, fallback to compatible smaller variant.
Ben: For incentives: try two arms — credit-based (API credit) vs concierge onboarding (1:1 session). Track commitment conversion and retention. Small randomized test.
Olivia: I put a short doc here: https://redwood.atlassian.com/dp-trajectory-gates (draft). Also added a poll in the doc for preferred incentive.
cs-bot: FYI — pilot partners flagged for support readiness: AcmeHealth, FinLedger, EchoForms. They have higher-security reqs.
Raj: Window for decisioning? I'd like a 14-day measurement window for commit rate, but initial canary open for 7 days to validate infra. Then expand if all gates pass at day 14.
Sophie: Proposed gating criteria (draft):
```
- commit_rate >= 0.30 (7d rolling)
- NPS >= 7 (week 2 survey)
- quality_regression <= 2% (auto-eval on canonical prompt set)
- p95_latency < 800ms (7d)
- support_incidents <= 5/day (week)
```
Carmen: That looks good. Need to add rollback plan and who owns each gate. Assignments?
Ben: I'll own commit_rate + incentive A/B analysis.
Raj: I'll own quality regression eval harness and daily automated alerts.
Kevin: I'll own capacity gate + fallback config.
Sophie: I'll coordinate human review sampling and NPS survey.
Olivia: I'll draft the launch checklist and SLA language for partners. Adding to the doc now.
Carmen: Great. Next steps: Olivia updates doc w/ ownership + timelines, Raj wires auto-eval. We'll reconvene Fri to finalize thresholds and cadence. :eyes:
Ben: +1. I'll prepare the incentive experiment matrix.
Kevin: I'll add fallback playbook to ops runbook.
Sophie: Scheduling human review slots, tagging partner contacts.
Carmen: Thanks all — short sync on Friday.
